members.name: _doIconExitTransition
members.description: Function that adds a CSS class to "fade out" the icon. The promise resolves after 100ms.

members.name: _doIconEnterTransition
members.description:
Function that removes the CSS class that "faded out" the icon.
So it basically sets is back to the original state. The promise resolves after 100ms.
